about: C3a Bar (PLAN 2.4 C3a T5, 1.6, 1.7; CC 3.1, 10). The bar's native cover is the three glass pieces 30-bar.css draws:
the Home circle (the Steam tab's Bookend surface), the apps capsule (the Tabs section of the main BarSurface: app tabs and +)
and the system capsule (Tray: Playspace, Room View, Streaming, the status pill, the avatar). The main BarSurface itself is
transparent in the theme, so the old two-shape cover (00-base.json) would glass the gap between the capsules. Not flagged:
the shapes follow the T1 CSS, which is always on. No pops on the bar (PLAN 1.7: bar popups are their own quads at +25 mm,
theme/popups/30-bar.json; tooltips are CSS shadow only). notifications, volumelevel and tooltip covers are in 00-base.json
A fourth piece when the glass tuner is on (flag glassTune, rt 33-tune.js): the paintbrush circle .lgs-tune after the system capsule.
